title: 第11章 双倍赔偿第12章 再遇三小姐
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
自从干上修仙城市收废品的行当，李凡便羡慕那些有店铺的商家，他们不用风里来雨里去，在店铺里，一转手废品，就可以赚大把大把的灵石。
弄这么一家店铺，是李凡新的梦想。
但是，李凡做梦也没想到，自己的梦想会这么快实现。
这一切，都必须归功于神奇的大铁锅。
这家店铺，并不是购买，而是二十年的租约，如今李凡接手，还剩十一年的使用权。
其他的东西，包括货架，展厅，后院，以及可以居住的房间等等，这一切店主都没有拿走，全部转让给李凡。
三千八百块灵石！
李凡也付出一笔巨款。
不要说炼气期中期，即使是筑基期前辈，拿出这么一大笔灵石，也不是一件容易的事。
办理完转让手续，店主把所有钥匙，交到李凡手中，然后雇来一辆货车，拉着自己的东西，依依不舍的离开。
都已经到街角，店主还在不时的回头，眺望他生活半辈子的地方。
或许，还有理想彻底破灭的失落。
李凡也是深有感触，如果没有神奇的大铁锅，自己最终的结局，或许还不如这位店主。
甩掉心中的杂念，李凡开始整理整个店铺。
而原来这个店面的小伙计，被李凡留下来，并且给他加酬劳，一个月十块灵石。
这个小伙计名叫张二嘎，也是小地方来这里讨生活的，同样是炼气二层的修为，只是他的资质稍微好一点，四灵根。
前几天里，张二嘎还一脸愁容，以为店铺转让后，自己很可能失业，再找一个修仙界的差事，谈何容易。
可是，让张二嘎高兴的是，这个只比自己大几个月的新店主，不仅留下自己，还每个月多给自己三块灵石的酬劳。
不过，在张二嘎眼里，这个新东家的规矩比较多，首先一条，自己的活动范围，只能在店铺，而后院，居住的房间，都是他的禁区，严禁他进入。
无奈，张二嘎晚上只能在店铺里搭个简单的木板将就一下。

整条修仙界大街，多出一家名叫好客来的店铺，并没有引起任何人的注意。
店铺开业，生意有点惨淡，即使是原来的老客户，看店主换成这么一位年纪轻轻，毫不起眼的年轻人，也都心里没底。
店铺生意一落千丈，李凡却一点不往心里去。
安定下来后，李凡又开始进入修炼的生涯。
他把一天的修炼内容，安排的明明白白。
白天，他躲在后院居住的房间，修炼五灵升仙经。
晚上，则是趁着夜色，偷偷练习九转登天步。
五灵升仙经的修炼，还算顺利，暂时没有遇到瓶颈，只是修炼速度，有一点缓慢。
毕竟自己不是天才的资质，速度慢一点，理所当然，李凡根本不往心里去。
而九转登天步的修炼，竟然不再异常艰难。
自从第一步修炼成功后，下面的修炼，开始顺利许多。
岁月如梭。
转眼间，五个月的时间，李凡的修炼再次出现问题。
期间，李凡收到的废弃法器，全部修复完毕，再转手卖出去。
得到的灵石，全部复制，得到的两万多灵石。
加上以前攒下的灵石，将近四万灵石，五个月时间，全部消耗殆尽。
content_en:
Ever since he got into the business of collecting scraps in Xiuxian City, Li Fan has been envious of those merchants who have shops. They don't have to go through wind and rain. In the shops, they can make a lot of spiritual stones by reselling scraps.
It is Li Fanxin’s dream to open such a store.
However, Li Fan never dreamed that his dream would come true so soon.
All this must be attributed to the magical big iron pot.
This store was not purchased, but leased for twenty years. Now that Li Fan has taken over, he still has eleven years of use rights.
Other things, including shelves, exhibition halls, backyards, and living rooms, etc., were not taken away by the shop owner and were all transferred to Li Fan.
Thirty-eight hundred spiritual stones!
Li Fan also paid a huge sum of money.
Not to mention the mid-Qi Refining Stage, even for seniors in the Foundation Establishment Stage, it is not easy to come up with such a large amount of spiritual stones.
After completing the transfer procedures, the shop owner handed all the keys to Li Fan, hired a truck, pulled his belongings, and left reluctantly.
They have already reached the corner of the street, but the shop owner is still looking back from time to time, looking at the place where he has lived for half his life.
Perhaps, there is also the loss of completely shattered ideals.
Li Fan also felt deeply that without the magical big iron pot, his final outcome might not be as good as this shop owner.
Getting rid of the distracting thoughts in his mind, Li Fan began to tidy up the entire store.
But it turned out that Li Fan kept the young man in this store and gave him an extra reward, ten spiritual stones a month.
This young man's name is Zhang Erga, and he also comes here to make a living in a small place. He is also at the second level of Qi Refining, but his qualifications are slightly better, with four spiritual roots.
In the past few days, Zhang Erga had a sad look on his face, thinking that after the store was transferred, he would probably lose his job, and finding another job in the world of immortality would not be easy.
However, what makes Zhang Erga happy is that this new shop owner, who is only a few months older than him, not only keeps him, but also pays him three more spiritual stones every month.
However, in Zhang Erga's eyes, this new owner has many rules. First of all, his scope of activities can only be in the shop, and the backyard and living room are his restricted areas, and he is strictly prohibited from entering.
Helpless, Zhang Erga could only make do with a simple wooden board in the shop at night.
On the entire Xiuxianjie Street, there was an extra store called Haokelai, but it didn't attract anyone's attention.
When the store opened, business was a bit bleak. Even the old customers felt unsure when the store owner was replaced by such a young and unremarkable young man.
The store's business plummeted, but Li Fan didn't take it seriously at all.
After settling down, Li Fan began to enter his cultivation career again.
He clearly arranged the contents of the day's practice.
During the day, he hid in his room in the backyard and practiced the Five Spirits Ascension Sutra.
At night, he took advantage of the darkness to secretly practice the Nine Turns to Heaven Step.
The cultivation of the Five Spirits Ascending Immortal Sutra is going quite smoothly, and there are no bottlenecks for the time being, but the cultivation speed is a bit slow.
After all, he is not a genius. It is natural that he is slower. Li Fan doesn't take it to heart at all.
However, the cultivation of the Nine-turn Heavenly Step is no longer extremely difficult.
Since the first step of cultivation was successful, the following cultivation began to go much more smoothly.
Time flies.
In the blink of an eye, within five months, Li Fan's practice had problems again.
During this period, Li Fan repaired all the discarded magical artifacts he received and then resold them.
All the spirit stones obtained were copied, and more than 20,000 spirit stones were obtained.
Including the spiritual stones saved before, there were nearly 40,000 spiritual stones, all of which were consumed in five months.
